queries.result: The first-party/local result documents Kashan’s electronic map system for building-permit plans, developed with Kashan Municipality, and says access requires a user account; it does not expose a public cadastral parcel layer. National cadastral references describe restricted surveying/cadastre systems, not an anonymous city polygon endpoint.

officialSources.observation: The Kashan branch of Iran’s Construction Engineering Organization says, in cooperation with Kashan Municipality, it designed and launched an electronic system for registering and approving building-permit plans. It describes an integrated archive containing plan, area, property-location and related records for engineers, the organization and the municipality, and says engineers must obtain a username and password in person. This evidences a local map/procedure custodian, not a public cadastral parcel-geometry service.

The first-party Kashan engineering-organization page links engineer and owner entry points at sana.kashannezam.ir for the electronic map system and identifies the Kashan branch. The linked service was not anonymously retrievable during this attempt.
National cadastral portal candidate identified by discovery; no anonymous public parcel API was established.
